title: Explicit schema-less Hostinger runtime bootstrap and recovery contract

phases.objective: Provide an explicit plan/dry-run/operation-scoped recovery contract for GitHub or a separately configured Hostinger release hook, while preserving normal DB-backed authorization and preventing startup auto-apply.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: hostinger-runtime-bootstrap CLI or manual GitHub workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Plan mode is read-only by default; dry-run classifies target schema, ledger, postconditions, and grants; apply_migration and apply_grants are separate operations with independent exact SHA/target/identity confirmations, while combined apply is denied.
steps: Validate exact Production source repository, branch, and 40-character SHA.
Validate a repository-owned target entry with database SHA-256 and target fingerprint bound to repository, branch, key, runtime/governance databases, principal, and principal host.

Use dedicated bootstrap credentials for repository_allowlist and capsule paths; allow existing DB_*, GOVERNANCE_DB_*, and RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB_* only under the separately explicit host_local_role_env Host Breakglass exception.

For dry-run only, allow an explicit runtime_env source to derive DB_NAME/DB_USER locally from Hostinger, use DB_NAME as the connection database when MYSQL_BOOTSTRAP_DATABASE is absent, and expose only hashes/configured flags.

Keep runtime_env DB_* reuse read-only; allow host_local_role_env role-bound migration or separately confirmed least-privilege grants only on the Hostinger host, never in GitHub Actions, repository_allowlist, SQL capsules, or shell execution.
Classify zero-table and nonempty databases before any baseline decision.
Allow 225 and 1048 only in dry-run/verification mode and read back their canonical schema/readiness postconditions.

Allow 20260815 only in apply_migration/apply_grants operation scopes; migration apply requires catalog prerequisite tables, checksum, statement count, ledger conflict checks, and declared postconditions, while grants require migration readiness and a separate confirmation.

For zero-table apply, require a same-SHA schema-only bundle manifest and separate runtime, governance, and runtime_persistence role table-count/checksum pins; execute the bounded runbook graph and read back governed_tool_response_chunks in the same cycle without executing a generic migration directory.

Preflight all six grant tables before the first GRANT, apply only SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE, record completed tables, and require same-cycle readback without GRANT OPTION or schema/global write privileges.
Validate all existing Hostinger role-specific users, passwords, database bindings, and unique principals before opening the first role connection; never copy role credentials to GitHub.
Issue host-local migration and grant handoffs separately with exact Production SHA, bounded runbook, explicit Host Breakglass marker, and operation-specific typed confirmation.
Expose typed bootstrap_not_configured/bootstrap_required status from startup and /deployment-info without opening a database connection.
Keep the normal GPT tool and session-context routes DB-backed and protected.
Resolve a repository-owned capability runbook and bind its exact tool contract SHA-256 before dispatch.
Before Production dispatch, recover any exact-correlation GitHub workflow run after process restart and reject ambiguous matches without issuing another POST.
For command exceptions, accept repository capsules only; require exact capsule hash and typed confirmation, plus Production backup/restore evidence.
Execute Production shell capsules through pinned known-hosts and key-only SSH, and return only bounded output hashes.
assertions: No plan/default startup/prestart/Docker start path performs database connection or mutation.
npm start, prestart, root start, and Dockerfile do not invoke the bootstrap CLI.
Missing bundle, source mismatch, table-count mismatch, or checksum mismatch blocks zero-table mutation before SQL.
A nonempty database cannot use the baseline bundle.
A schema-ready database without apply-ledger evidence remains apply-required and is never record-only reconciled.
Credential values, SQL text, raw database/principal values, and passwords are absent from bounded evidence; failed DDL/GRANT attempts report unknown/partial mutation state and completed counts.
The protected host-side runtime bootstrap dry-run route rejects missing backend authentication, accepts no database name from the request, and returns no mutation flags.
Runtime Breakglass status and plans are database-independent, service-key-only, and never expose credentials or target database values.

Combined apply is denied; migration and grants approvals are independent, and the repository does not claim that Hostinger release-hook configuration exists; live operational execution remains a separate step.
Host-local role credentials remain database-bound, user-unique, secret-free, Production-only, and unavailable to GitHub workflow dispatch.

The host-local grant exception allows only separately approved SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on the six allowlisted runtime tables and never issues governance, persistence, global, schema, or GRANT OPTION privileges.
Inline SQL and shell payloads are rejected; only exact-SHA repository capsules can execute.
Production SQL rejects global, cross-schema, or grantable bootstrap identities before capsule execution.
Production SSH never disables host-key checking and never serializes command output or credentials.
